# /adopt — brownfield adoption: discover, draft, apply, promote (human-gated)

Thin macro over the **already-coded** adoption pipeline. Do NOT re-implement discovery, drafting,
application, or promotion logic — `tools.adoption_scan` (discovery) and `tools.adoption_apply`
(task-local batch drafting, atomic/collision-safe apply, human-ratification promotion) already
encode the full workflow (ADOPT-04..07).

## Sub-verbs

`$ARGUMENTS` carries the sub-verb as its first token, followed by that sub-verb's own flags, passed
**positionally** to the underlying module — never interpolated into a constructed shell string:

### discover

Read-only scan of a target tree into `inventory.json`/`plan.json`/`manifest.json` under a
required, target-external `--out` directory:

!`python -m tools.adoption_scan $ARGUMENTS`

### draft

Create-or-resume a task-local adoption batch — writes the same three artifacts confined to
`<task-dir>/artifacts/adoption/<batch-id>/`, never outside that root:

!`python -m tools.adoption_apply draft $ARGUMENTS`

### apply

Apply a drafted batch's manifest dispositions against a target root — atomic, collision-safe,
idempotent; refuses any constitution-plane (`contracts/` · `docs/adr/` · `golden/`) destination
before any write:

!`python -m tools.adoption_apply apply $ARGUMENTS`

### promote

Ratify a batch's reviewed decisions into `approval.json`:

!`python -m tools.adoption_apply promote $ARGUMENTS`

## The human gate (refusal is the default)

Promotion is **REFUSED** (`AdoptionApprovalRefused`, CLI **exit 3**) unless ALL of the following
are present:

1. an explicit human `--approve` flag,
2. at least one reviewed `--decisions` entry, and
3. a `--confirm <value>` human confirmation value matching the `$GOLDEN_APPROVE_HUMAN` env var
   — a value an agent is instructed **never** to fabricate.

An agent running this command **cannot** self-approve: without the human confirmation value the
tool refuses and exits 3. A stored approval is bound to `(draft_hash, task_revision, git_ref)`,
recomputed fresh at every validity check — changing any one of the three independently
invalidates a prior approval, no partial credit. Affirmative promotion is a human-only action.

Example (human-run):

```
python -m tools.adoption_apply promote --task-dir .workflow/tasks/T-0001 --batch-id <id> \
  --repo-root . --approve --decisions decisions.json --confirm "$GOLDEN_APPROVE_HUMAN"
```

## Notes

- **No arbitrary command execution.** Every invocation above is a fixed `python -m
  tools.adoption_scan`/`tools.adoption_apply <sub-verb>` argv form; `$ARGUMENTS` is passed
  positionally, never woven into a shell string built from manifest/draft/scanned content.
- **Discovery is read-only**; `apply` never touches the constitution plane; `promote` never
  self-approves. See `harness/skills/brownfield-adoption/SKILL.md` for the full lifecycle runbook.
